evidence_chain: Fact: Ichor describes itself as a designer, engineer and manufacturer of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components primarily for semiconductor capital equipment, including gas and chemical delivery subsystems that are key elements of process tools. Source: SEC FY2025 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000012/ichr-20251226.htm.

Fact: Ichor states that its gas delivery subsystems deliver, monitor and control specialized gases used in semiconductor processes such as etch and deposition; its chemical delivery subsystems blend and dispense reactive liquid chemistries used in CMP, electroplating and cleaning. Source: SEC FY2025 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000012/ichr-20251226.htm.

Fact: Ichor states that fluid delivery malfunction or material degradation can reduce yields and increase manufacturing defects, and that most OEMs outsource all or part of gas delivery subsystem design, engineering and manufacturing to a few specialized suppliers including Ichor. Source: SEC FY2025 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000012/ichr-20251226.htm.

Fact: Ichor states that early engagement with customers may allow it to design to precise specifications, be sole supplier during initial production ramp, and become preferred supplier for the full lifespan of a process tool. This is company language, not independent proof of current sole-source status on a named platform. Source: SEC FY2025 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000012/ichr-20251226.htm.

Fact: Lam Research and Applied Materials accounted for a combined 76% of Ichor's total sales in fiscal 2025; Ichor also says Lam and Applied have been customers for over 20 years, but it has no long-term contracts requiring fixed or minimum order volumes. Source: SEC FY2025 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000012/ichr-20251226.htm.

Fact: Ichor reported FY2025 revenue of $947.7 million, up 11.6% year over year, with GAAP gross margin of 9.3% and non-GAAP gross margin of 12.2%. Source: FY2025 earnings release filed with 10-K context, https://last10k.com/sec-filings/ichr/0001652535-26-000012.htm.

Fact: In Q1 2026, Ichor reported revenue of $256.1 million, up 15% sequentially from Q4 2025, GAAP gross margin of 12.6%, and non-GAAP gross margin of 12.8%. Management said the quarter benefited from a strengthening demand environment and expected another quarter of sequential improvement. Source: Q1 2026 earnings release, https://last10k.com/sec-filings/ichr/0001652535-26-000031.htm.

Fact: Ichor's Q1 2026 10-Q says semiconductor equipment spending momentum continued into Q1 2026, characterized by robust demand in its primary markets of etch and deposition, and that Q1 net sales growth reflected sustained demand from primary customers and served markets. Source: SEC Q1 2026 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000031/ichr-20260327.htm.

Fact: Ichor's Q1 2026 gross margin increased to 12.6% from 11.7% in Q1 2025; the company attributed the improvement primarily to the non-repeat of prior severance charges and increased factory utilization. Source: SEC Q1 2026 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000031/ichr-20260327.htm.

Fact: Ichor used $2.9 million of operating cash in Q1 2026, with unfavorable working-capital movement driven by increases in accounts receivable and inventory, partially offset by accounts payable. Source: SEC Q1 2026 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652535/000165253526000031/ichr-20260327.htm.

Fact: As of June 11, 2026 10:08:59 UTC, web finance data showed ICHR market capitalization of approximately $2.50 billion, placing it in the mid-cap bucket for this funnel. Source: web finance lookup.

Inference: The combination of high Lam/Applied concentration, 20-year relationships, etch/deposition exposure, and company language about sole-supplier status during initial ramps makes Ichor a plausible subsystem chokepoint candidate, but this remains an inference until platform-specific qualifications, share data, or named design wins are verified.

Hypothesis: AI-driven leading-edge WFE demand can flow into Ichor through OEM etch/deposition platforms, but Q1 2026 disclosures do not yet isolate AI, HBM, leading-edge logic, or a specific tool platform as the driver.
falsification_plan: Downgrade if revenue growth tracks only generic WFE recovery while Ichor provides no evidence of new platform wins, qualification progress, or share gains at Lam/Applied.
Downgrade if top-customer concentration falls because Lam or Applied shift share away from Ichor rather than because Ichor diversifies into new OEMs or non-semi markets.
Downgrade if Q2-Q4 2026 revenue rises but GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins fail to improve, suggesting weak pricing power, poor absorption, or costly ramp execution.
Downgrade if inventories and receivables continue to rise faster than revenue without later cash conversion, implying working-capital drag rather than chokepoint economics.
Downgrade if OEM commentary or procurement evidence indicates aggressive dual-sourcing, redesign around Ichor modules, or shorter qualification cycles than assumed.
Downgrade if etch/deposition demand at Lam/Applied weakens while Ichor cannot offset with wet-process, ASML, aerospace/defense, medical, or commercial-space growth.

Upgrade only if primary sources show named platform qualification, sole/dual-source status, preferred-supplier status, design-win language, or sustained margin expansion tied to higher utilization and mix rather than one-time cost actions.
deep_reports.hidden_signal_to_verify: The hidden signal is not broad WFE commentary; it is whether Ichor is sole-sourced, dual-sourced, or preferred-sourced on specific Lam Research or Applied Materials etch/deposition platforms, and whether Q2-Q4 2026 revenue growth is accompanied by clean-room/factory utilization improvement, non-GAAP gross-margin expansion, and stable or rising share at top OEM customers.
next_research_tasks: Pull Ichor Q2 2026 earnings release and 10-Q when filed; compare revenue, GAAP gross margin, non-GAAP gross margin, operating cash flow, inventories, accounts receivable, and utilization commentary against Q1 2026.

Search Ichor investor presentations, earnings-call transcripts, and conference materials for the words: platform, qualification, sole source, dual source, preferred supplier, Lam, Applied, etch, deposition, gas box, chemical delivery, utilization, clean room.
Map Ichor product categories to OEM platforms: gas delivery subsystems, chemical delivery, weldments, precision machining, advanced flow controller, valves and specialty joining.

Check Lam Research and Applied Materials filings/calls for 2026 etch/deposition demand, outsourcing, supplier constraints, lead times, and any mention of fluid delivery, gas boxes, subsystems or Ichor.
Build a customer-concentration time series for Lam, Applied, ASML and other top customers from Ichor 10-Ks for FY2020-FY2025 and future filings; distinguish share loss from diversification.
Benchmark Ichor against MKS Instruments, Ultra Clean Holdings, VAT Group, Entegris, Cohu-like subsystem/tooling peers and private suppliers to understand whether Ichor's role is truly scarce.
Verify manufacturing footprint and capacity: Malaysia, Oregon, Texas, California, Minnesota, Mexico and any clean-room or high-volume facility expansion; track capex as percentage of sales.
Track restructuring execution after the Scotland/Korea closure and machining-asset relocation; verify whether footprint consolidation improves utilization and gross margin.
Investigate patents and product literature around Ichor's advanced flow controller and mass-flow replacement claims; assess whether this is a real differentiated component or a small product feature.

Interview-style diligence checklist: ask whether customers can qualify an alternate supplier in months or years, whether Ichor owns process know-how or merely builds to print, and whether pricing resets during ramps.
risks: Customer concentration risk: Lam Research and Applied Materials represented 76% of FY2025 sales; this can be evidence of integration but also creates bargaining-power and order-volatility risk.
No guaranteed volume: Ichor discloses that it does not have long-term contracts requiring customers to place fixed or minimum order quantities.
Cyclicality risk: semiconductor capital equipment is inherently cyclical; revenue recovery could reflect broad WFE restocking rather than defensible platform share.
Pricing-power risk: major OEM customers may require reduced prices or delivery/quality commitments, pressuring gross margin even if volume rises.
Evidence gap: no public source in this evidence set proves Ichor is sole-sourced or dual-sourced on a named Lam or Applied platform today.
Working-capital risk: Q1 2026 operating cash flow was negative as receivables and inventories increased during the ramp.

Tariff/export-control risk: Ichor identifies global tariffs and U.S. export controls, especially around advanced semiconductor technology and China, as factors that could affect demand, costs and supply chain operations.
Execution risk: restructuring and manufacturing footprint rationalization may improve utilization, but could also disrupt capacity, quality, or delivery performance if poorly executed.
Margin-quality risk: Q1 2026 margin improvement was partly due to non-repeat of severance charges; sustained improvement must be separated from temporary cost effects.

Substitution/internalization risk: OEMs could dual-source more aggressively, redesign modules, or internalize subsystem work if supply-chain resilience becomes more important than outsourcing efficiency.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: AI compute demand -> leading-edge logic/HBM/advanced-node capacity -> wafer fab equipment capex -> etch/deposition/wet-process tools from OEMs such as Lam Research, Applied Materials, ASML and peers -> outsourced fluid delivery subsystems -> gas boxes, chemical delivery modules, weldments, precision machining, valves/flow-control components -> Ichor manufacturing footprint in the U.S., Malaysia, Mexico and other facilities. CN: Ichor 位于前道设备 OEM 内部子系统层，不直接卖 AI 芯片或服务器，而是通过刻蚀、沉积、清洗、CMP 等制程设备需求间接受益。
deep_reports.thesis_cn: 假设：Ichor 可能不是普通周期性半导体设备零部件供应商，而是嵌入 Lam Research、Applied Materials、ASML 等前道设备 OEM 平台的气体与化学液体输送子系统供应商。其气体输送子系统用于刻蚀、CVD、PVD、外延、strip、光刻等 dry process 工具；化学液体输送产品用于 wet clean、电化学沉积、CMP 等 wet process。若 Ichor 在具体下一代平台上早期参与设计、完成客户认证，并在初始量产爬坡阶段成为 sole supplier 或 preferred supplier，则客户切换成本、验证周期和质量风险可能使其具备一定瓶颈属性。当前证据支持“值得深挖”，但尚不足以证明其在某些 Lam/Applied 平台上具有不可替代或长期独占地位。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Hypothesis: Ichor may be more than a generic cyclical semiconductor-equipment supplier; it may be a qualified gas and chemical delivery subsystem vendor embedded inside OEM tools from Lam Research, Applied Materials, ASML, and others. Its gas delivery subsystems are used in dry-process tools such as etch, CVD, PVD, epitaxy, strip, and lithography, while its chemical delivery products serve wet clean, electrochemical deposition, and CMP. If Ichor is designed in early, qualified on next-generation platforms, and becomes sole or preferred supplier during initial ramps, the validation burden, yield-risk implications, and OEM switching cost could make the role more chokepoint-like. Current evidence supports a deep-research candidate, but does not yet prove platform-specific sole-source or durable share lock-in.

deep_reports.why_underfollowed: Ichor is screened and categorized as a small/mid-cap cyclical semiconductor capital-equipment supplier, which can obscure a narrower question: whether customer-qualified fluid delivery subsystems are sticky once designed into specific OEM process tools. Customer concentration also screens as a risk, but in the Serenity chokepoint framework it may be dual-use evidence: risk if pricing power is weak, but a possible signal of deep platform integration if paired with long qualification, design-in wins, and margin recovery.

evidence.summary: Ichor FY2025 10-K: describes fluid delivery subsystem business, gas/chemical delivery applications, OEM outsourcing, early design engagement, sole-supplier ramp language, Lam/Applied/ASML customer relationships, FY2025 revenue and customer concentration.

Ichor Q1 2026 10-Q: reports Q1 revenue, margins, operating cash flow, working-capital changes, etch/deposition demand commentary, utilization-related gross-margin improvement and risk language around tariffs/export controls.
Q1 2026 earnings release: revenue $256.1 million, GAAP gross margin 12.6%, non-GAAP gross margin 12.8%, sequential revenue improvement and management outlook for further sequential improvement.
FY2025 earnings release: revenue $947.7 million, GAAP gross margin 9.3%, non-GAAP gross margin 12.2%, and management commentary that demand entering FY2026 was improving from Q4 trough levels.
Web finance lookup showed ICHR price of $72.17 and market capitalization of approximately $2.50 billion at 10:08:59 UTC on June 11, 2026.

Serenity framework directs the research to start from the technology theme, map demand drivers and supply-chain bottlenecks, prefer underfollowed small/mid-cap candidates, separate fact/inference/hypothesis/speculation, and build falsification plans.

CN: Ichor 的研究价值不在于泛泛判断 WFE 复苏，而在于验证其是否是 Lam Research、Applied Materials 等前道设备 OEM 的平台合格气体/化学液体输送子系统供应商，并在先进制程、刻蚀、沉积平台需求上获得订单、产能利用率和毛利率转化。EN: The investable research question is not generic WFE recovery; it is whether Ichor is a qualified, hard-to-substitute fluid-delivery subsystem supplier embedded in leading etch/deposition platforms, with evidence visible through customer concentration, qualification language, utilization, gross margin, and order conversion. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
